httpOnly.scheduled: The WebSocket is off. Encore syncs the library on a schedule instead of live, and can't see what {{name}} is playing until you enable Settings › Services › Control › Allow remote control from applications on other systems.
httpOnly.viaSource: The WebSocket is off. Library updates still arrive through {{source}} (the library source), but Encore can't see what {{name}} is playing until you enable Settings › Services › Control › Allow remote control from applications on other systems.

card.offline: Encore can't reach {{name}}. Check that Kodi is running and that the address below is right.

discovered.title: Found on your network

common.many: Encore keeps one library and one title index for them, syncs it from the library source, and listens for changes from all of them.
common.two: Encore keeps one library and one title index for them, syncs it from the library source, and listens for changes from both.

confirmed.many: These instances use the same Kodi database: playback on one changed the watched status and resume point on all of them at once.
confirmed.two: These instances use the same Kodi database: playback on one changed the watched status and resume point on both at once.

check.many: The next time something is played, Encore checks that the watched status and resume point change on all of them at once; when they do, this becomes Confirmed shared.
check.two: The next time something is played, Encore checks that the watched status and resume point change on both instances at once; when they do, this becomes Confirmed shared.

likely.evidence: These instances appear to use the same Kodi database: {{evidence}}.
likely.plain: These instances appear to use the same Kodi database.

explanation.manual: You grouped these instances by hand.

library.fallback: The source is unreachable, so Encore is syncing from {{name}}.

share.alreadyShared: Shares a library with {{names}}; ticking it moves it into this one.
share.description: Tick the Kodi instances that use the same Kodi database, such as MySQL. Encore then keeps one library and title index for them.
share.sourceHint: The first instance you tick becomes the library source; you can change it afterwards.
share.title: Share a library

library.sourceHint: If the source is asleep, Encore syncs from another instance in the group that is awake. Playback still goes to whichever instance the Echo controls.

split.description: Pick the instance that has its own Kodi database. Encore then syncs and indexes it separately.
split.title: Split the shared library
